blocks.text: As the Christmas season approaches, hotel and resort staycations offer Cebuano families and couples another way to enjoy the holidays without traveling far from home. In Mactan, Lapu-Lapu City, beachfront properties provide opportunities to combine relaxation, dining, and leisure in one destination, giving guests a chance to step away from their usual routines and spend more time together. For many households, the holidays come with a familiar list of responsibilities, from preparing meals and buying gifts to attending gatherings and welcoming visitors. While these traditions remain part of Christmas, a short getaway can offer a different kind of celebration; one where […]...
